forBusinessMetadata.title: ScrollBooker for Business — New Clients from Video, Free During the Pilot
forBusinessMetadata.description: Clients discover you through video and book or contact you directly. An online calendar and complete management, free for the whole pilot period. Register your salon on ScrollBooker.

forBusinessTeaser.title: Own a salon or work in beauty? Let clients discover you.
forBusinessTeaser.subtitle: Post videos of your best work, show up in the feed of people nearby and get clients straight from your videos.

items.title: Post videos
items.description: Transformations, techniques, the vibe of your salon — the content you already make.

items.title: Get discovered locally
items.description: Your videos reach people nearby who are looking for exactly what you offer.

items.title: Get clients
items.description: Instant booking or a WhatsApp message — you choose how they reach you.

forBusinessHero.launchOffer: Everything is free for the whole pilot period.
forBusinessHero.subtitle: Already posting on Instagram or TikTok? On ScrollBooker, clients discover your services through video and book or contact you straight from your content — and for running the business, you get an online calendar, services, and staff, all in one place.
forBusinessHero.imageAlt: A ScrollBooker business profile, with video content, reviews, and instant booking

forBusinessCalendar.title: Your schedule, always up to date, with zero effort
forBusinessCalendar.subtitle: Each staff member has their own calendar, automatically updated with every booking — you always see real availability, with no manual tracking.
forBusinessCalendar.imageAlt: ScrollBooker smart calendar, with automatically synced bookings

items.title: Real-time availability
items.description: Clients only see the slots that are genuinely free — no risk of overlap.

items.title: One calendar per staff member
items.description: Each team member manages their own schedule, automatically synced with the business's overall calendar.

items.title: Automatic updates
items.description: Any new booking, cancellation, or change is reflected instantly, with no refresh or manual work.

forBusinessDiscovery.kicker: You don't have to post video content
forBusinessDiscovery.title: Clients can find you other ways too, right in the app
forBusinessDiscovery.subtitle: Video content helps you grow faster, but it isn't required — your profile stays fully functional and discoverable through the app's other channels.
forBusinessDiscovery.imageAlt: The ScrollBooker search screen, with a map and filters for finding businesses

channels.title: Map search & filters
channels.description: Clients search directly on the map and filter by service, location, or hours — they find you actively, even before they follow you.

channels.title: Your business profile
channels.description: Stays complete, with services, hours, and a booking button, whether you post video content or not.

channels.title: Client reviews
channels.description: Your score and reviews show up right on your profile and boost your visibility in search, independent of any content you post.

forBusinessHowItWorks.title: From sign-up to your first booking

steps.title: You sign up
steps.description: Fill in your business details — it takes a few minutes, straight from the browser, no app install needed.

steps.title: You set up your profile
steps.description: Add a photo gallery, your services, your working hours, and, if it applies, your staff.

steps.title: You get bookings
steps.description: Once approved, your profile becomes visible in the app — clients discover you and book or contact you directly.

forBusinessBookingModes.kicker: You choose how clients reach you
forBusinessBookingModes.title: With Instant Booking or without — whatever suits you
forBusinessBookingModes.subtitle: Clients see your videos, prices, location and reviews. What happens when they want to come to you is up to you, in your settings.

modes.title: Clients book themselves
modes.description: They pick a service and a free slot in your calendar, and the booking lands in your schedule automatically — no phone calls.
modes.fit: A good fit if you have a clear schedule and want a full calendar without answering the phone.

modes.title: Clients contact you directly
modes.description: Instead of a booking button, clients see WhatsApp and call buttons. You choose phone, WhatsApp or both.
steps: You agree on a time together
modes.fit: A good fit if you prefer talking to each client or already keep your schedule elsewhere.

notes: Turn Instant Booking on or off anytime, from your settings.
Clients pay at the salon, just like today — ScrollBooker never collects money from your clients.

forBusinessFaq.title: What businesses ask before signing up

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: During the pilot, ScrollBooker is completely free. We’ll tell you about the plans after the pilot well in advance, before you pay anything.

items.question: Do I have to turn on Instant Booking?
items.answer: No. By default, clients contact you by phone or WhatsApp and you agree on a time with them. Turn on Instant Booking only if you want bookings to go straight into your calendar.

items.question: Do I have to post videos?
items.answer: It’s not required. Videos help you get discovered faster, but your profile stays complete and findable through search, the map and reviews.

items.question: Do clients pay through the app?
items.answer: No. Clients pay at the salon, just like today. ScrollBooker never collects money from your clients.

items.question: I work on my own. Is it for me?
items.answer: Yes. Use a single calendar if you work alone, or one calendar per employee if you have a team.

items.question: Can I add employees?
items.answer: Yes. Invite your team into the app — each employee gets their own schedule and calendar, synced with the business’s overall schedule.

items.question: How long until I show up in the app?
items.answer: Signing up takes a few minutes. Once you complete your profile and we approve it, clients can see you.

items.question: Which cities are you in?
items.answer: We’re launching in Bucharest, with beauty businesses: hair and barber, nails, lashes and brows, make-up, skincare and massage. More cities will follow.
